sources.title: Welcome to ELI5's documentation! — ELI5 0.15.0 documentation
sources.snippet: Welcome to ELI5's documentation! ELI5 is a Python library which allows to visualize and debug various Machine Learning models using unified API. It has built-in support for several ML frameworks and provides a way to explain black-box models.
